pinned.note: 54 rules confirmed live: Bronze 20, Silver 10, Gold 21, Platinum 3. No Diamond tier exists. hacs.json floor: homeassistant 2024.6.0.

rules.title: Service actions are registered in async_setup
rules.check: Locate every hass.services.async_register / async_register call site; record the enclosing function (async_setup vs async_setup_entry vs other) per registration; count per site.

rules.title: If it's a polling integration, set an appropriate polling interval
rules.check: Extract the DataUpdateCoordinator update_interval (and any SCAN_INTERVAL) value(s) as constructed at runtime; report the concrete interval for this cloud-polling integration.

rules.title: Has branding assets available for the integration
rules.check: Custom components cannot join home-assistant/brands; adapted check: brand/icon.png + brand/logo.png exist in the integration dir, repo icon.png exists, HACS validate workflow green on the pinned SHA.

rules.title: Place common patterns in common modules
rules.check: coordinator.py exists and holds the DataUpdateCoordinator; entity.py exists and holds a base entity class; count platform files importing the shared base vs defining their own boilerplate.

rules.title: Integration needs to be able to be set up via the UI
rules.check: config_flow.py with stepped flows; count data_description usage on schema fields; ConfigEntry.data vs ConfigEntry.options usage split (options flow stores options, not data).

rules.title: Full test coverage for the config flow
rules.check: Tracked in issue #194; not re-measured this pass.

rules.title: Dependency transparency
rules.check: For each manifest requirement (numpy, scipy, threadpoolctl): OSI license name from PyPI metadata, PyPI presence, public CI in source repo, PyPI version maps to a tagged release.

rules.title: The documentation describes the provided service actions
rules.check: Enumerate services.yaml actions; grep docs/ + README for coverage of each action name; report uncovered actions.

rules.title: The documentation describes the provided triggers
rules.check: Count triggers the integration actually provides (device triggers / trigger platforms); if zero, the rule is vacuously satisfied — record the zero.

rules.title: The documentation describes the provided conditions
rules.check: Count conditions the integration actually provides; if zero, vacuously satisfied — record the zero.

rules.title: The documentation includes a high-level description
rules.check: README top section describes brand/product/service purpose in plain terms.

rules.title: Step-by-step installation instructions
rules.check: HACS/custom install steps incl. prerequisites present in README/docs.

rules.title: The documentation provides removal instructions
rules.check: Removal/uninstall instructions present (grep docs + README).

rules.title: Entity events are subscribed in the correct lifecycle methods
rules.check: Count event/state subscriptions per call site class: in async_added_to_hass (with async_on_remove cleanup) vs in __init__/other; report misplaced subscriptions.

rules.title: Entities have a unique ID
rules.check: Every entity class sets _attr_unique_id or unique_id property; instantiate/derive the 65 entity unique_ids and run a collision scan.

rules.title: Entities use has_entity_name = True
rules.check: _attr_has_entity_name = True set in base entity or every entity class; count exceptions.

rules.title: Use ConfigEntry.runtime_data to store runtime data
rules.check: Typed alias (type ...ConfigEntry = ConfigEntry[...]) defined and used in signatures; count entry.runtime_data reads vs hass.data[DOMAIN] reads across the integration.

rules.title: Test a connection in the config flow
rules.check: The config flow validates connectivity/credentials (Tibber token probe or equivalent) before entry creation; identify the validating symbol and the error branch when it fails.

rules.title: Check during initialization that we can set up
rules.check: async_setup_entry path raises ConfigEntryNotReady on transient failure / ConfigEntryAuthFailed on auth failure / ConfigEntryError permanent; count bare-raise or swallow sites in the setup path.

rules.title: Don't allow the same device or service to be set up twice
rules.check: async_set_unique_id + _abort_if_unique_id_configured (or _async_abort_entries_match) present in the user step; stub-run a duplicate submission and record the abort reason.

rules.title: Service actions raise exceptions when encountering failures
rules.check: Inventory raise sites in service + platform action handlers: ServiceValidationError for invalid usage, HomeAssistantError for failures; count silent-swallow except blocks in handlers.

rules.title: Support config entry unloading
rules.check: async_unload_entry implemented, forwards unload to platforms, tears down listeners/services; coordinator shutdown chain calls super() (D10-06 regression class); stub-run unload/reload and count leftover listeners.

rules.title: Documentation describes all integration configuration options
rules.check: Cross-check config flow + options flow schema fields against docs coverage; report undocumented options.

rules.title: Documentation describes all installation parameters
rules.check: Installation-time parameters (token, entity picks) documented; report undocumented parameters.

rules.title: Mark entity unavailable if appropriate
rules.check: Coordinator failure flips entity availability (last_update_success wiring); partial-missing data yields 'unknown' not stale values; stub-run a failed update and record entity states.

rules.title: Has an integration owner
rules.check: manifest codeowners non-empty and matches a real GitHub account.

rules.title: Log once when unavailable and once when back connected
rules.check: Outage/recovery logging fires exactly once per transition at info level (not per poll); stub-run N failed polls + 1 recovery and count log emissions.

rules.title: Number of parallel updates is specified
rules.check: PARALLEL_UPDATES constant present per platform module (sensor, binary_sensor, button, climate, switch); report per-file presence and value.

rules.title: Reauthentication available via the UI
rules.check: async_step_reauth/reauth_confirm implemented; an auth failure during update raises ConfigEntryAuthFailed which starts the flow; record the trigger path end-to-end.

rules.title: Above 95% test coverage for all integration modules
rules.check: Tracked in issue #195; not re-measured this pass.

rules.title: The integration creates devices
rules.check: DeviceInfo constructed with identifiers, manufacturer, model (+serial/hw/sw/via_device/connections where available); count DeviceInfo sites and field completeness.

rules.title: Implements diagnostics
rules.check: Config-entry (and device) diagnostics via async_get_config_entry_diagnostics; sensitive fields redacted (async_redact_data or explicit TO_REDACT); verify post-#210 state (diagnostics must not be a platform).

rules.title: Devices can be discovered
rules.check: Exemption candidate: integration binds to a cloud API (Tibber) + user-picked HA entities; record whether any discovery mechanism exists or the documented exemption applies.

rules.title: Integration uses discovery info to update network information
rules.check: Exemption candidate (same basis as discovery); no network addresses to update.

rules.title: Documentation describes how data is updated
rules.check: Docs explain polling cadence/sources (Tibber, weather, sensors).

rules.title: Documentation provides automation examples
rules.check: At least one usable automation example exercising integration services/entities.

rules.title: Documentation describes known limitations
rules.check: Limitations section present and non-trivial.

rules.title: Documentation describes known supported/unsupported devices
rules.check: Supported heat pump interfaces (switch, ECL110/MQTT) documented; exemption candidate if treated as non-device integration.

rules.title: Documentation describes supported functionality incl. entities and platforms
rules.check: Entity/platform inventory documented vs actual 65 entities/6 platforms; report the delta.

rules.title: Documentation provides troubleshooting information
rules.check: Troubleshooting section present, addresses common failure modes.

rules.title: Documentation describes use cases
rules.check: Use-case narratives present.

rules.title: Devices added after integration setup
rules.check: Exemption candidate: no device discovery at runtime; record the basis.

rules.title: Entities are assigned an appropriate EntityCategory
rules.check: Count entities per class with/without EntityCategory (diagnostic/config expected for internal signals); report uncategorized non-primary entities.

rules.title: Entities use device classes where possible
rules.check: Count sensors with an applicable SensorDeviceClass set vs total sensors; list measurable quantities lacking device_class.

rules.title: Integration disables less popular or noisy entities
rules.check: Count entities with entity_registry_enabled_default False vs total; report noisy/diagnostic entities enabled by default.

rules.title: Entities have translated names
rules.check: Every entity class sets _attr_translation_key with a matching strings.json entity entry (en + sv); report uncovered entities.

rules.title: Exception messages are translatable
rules.check: Raise sites of HomeAssistantError/ServiceValidationError use translation_domain/translation_key; strings.json carries an exceptions section covering them; count untranslated raise sites.

rules.title: Entities implement icon translations
rules.check: Tracked in issue #189; not re-measured this pass.

rules.title: Integrations should have a reconfigure flow
rules.check: Tracked in issue #196; not re-measured this pass.

rules.title: Repair issues and repair flows used when user intervention is needed
rules.check: ir.async_create_issue call sites with actionable severity/fix flow; map which user-intervention conditions raise issues vs only log.

rules.title: Stale devices are removed
rules.check: Exemption candidate: integration-defined device lifetime is static; record basis (or async_remove_config_entry_device presence).

rules.title: Dependency is async
rules.check: Integration performs HTTP via aiohttp async calls; count blocking IO in async paths (requests/time.sleep/open().read/etc.) — expected 0; executor wrapping for CPU-bound solves.

rules.title: The integration dependency supports passing in a websession
rules.check: All aiohttp sessions obtained via async_get_clientsession(hass) (incl. config flow + coordinator + open-meteo); count ad-hoc aiohttp.ClientSession() constructions.
